arxiv-2001-07528.title: Kernel-Cokernel Sequence for Composition and Its Applications
arxiv-2001-07528.creator: XIONG Rui
arxiv-2001-07528.description: Abstract If this article, an elementary kernel-cokernel exact sequence is introduced for A → f B → g C A\stackrel{{\scriptstyle f}}{{\to}}B\stackrel{{\scriptstyle g}}{{\to}}C . Some relative sequences and applications are discussed. This result can simplify some proofs—the indices of Frodholm operators, Harada and Sai theorem, and the derived couples of exact couples.

arxiv-2103-15788.title: A branch-and-cut algorithm for submodular interdiction games
arxiv-2103-15788.creator: Kübra Tanınmış, Markus Sinnl
arxiv-2103-15788.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Kübra Tanınmış, Markus Sinnl. Many relevant applications from diverse areas such as marketing, wildlife conservation or defending critical infrastructure can be modeled as interdiction games. In this work, we introduce interdiction games whose objective is a monotone and submodular set function.

arxiv-2211-02845.title: Triple hourglass Weyl phonons
arxiv-2211-02845.creator: Guang Liu, Zhongjia Chen, Peng Wu, Hu Xu
arxiv-2211-02845.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Guang Liu, Zhongjia Chen, Peng Wu, Hu Xu. Unconventional Weyl phonons with higher topological charges in crystalline solids have attracted increasing attention. By symmetry analysis and low-energy k ⋅ p \emph{\textbf{k}}\cdot\emph{\textbf{p}} effective Hamiltonian, we propose the symmetry enforced triple hourglass Weyl phonons (THWPs) with Chern number 𝒞 \mathcal{C} = ± \pm 3 protected by 6 3 6_{3} screw rotation symmetry in chiral space groups 173 ( P ​ 6 3 P6_{3} ) and 182 ( P ​ 6 3 ​ 22 P6_{3}22 ).

arxiv-2503-11681.title: Convolution and Combination Matrices in Non-stationary Filtering
arxiv-2503-11681.creator: Peter Zizler
arxiv-2503-11681.description: Abstract Time independent convolution yields circulant matrices whose eigenvectors are the Fourier exponentials with the eigenvalues being the Fourier transform of the mask. The case of time dependent convolution, the non-stationary case, no longer has this property and two matrices are then introduced, the cyclic convolution matrix and the cyclic combination matrix.

arxiv-2508-02677.title: Automated h h -adaptivity for finite element approximations of the Falkner-Skan equation
arxiv-2508-02677.creator: B. Veena S. N. Rao
arxiv-2508-02677.description: Abstract This paper details the development and application of an h h -adaptive finite element method for the numerical solution of the Falkner-Skan equation . A posteriori error estimation governs the adaptivity of the mesh, specifically the well-established Kelly error estimator , which utilizes the jump in the gradient across elements.

arxiv-2510-16002.title: Asymptotically well-balanced geostrophic reconstruction finite volumes numerical schemes for the 2D rotating NLSWE in spherical coordinates Thanks: Submitted to the editors DATE.
arxiv-2510-16002.creator: A. González, M.J. Castro, J. Macías
arxiv-2510-16002.description: Abstract The dynamics of large-scale geophysical fluids is primarily governed by the balance between the Coriolis force and the pressure gradient. This phenomenon, known as geostrophic equilibrium, is the basis for the geostrophic model, which has proven to be extremely useful for understanding and forecasting large-scale atmospheric and oceanic dynamics.

pmc-13388081.title: Outcomes following different thermal ablation strategies in patients with oligometastatic colorectal lung metastases
pmc-13388081.creator: Youzhuo Quan, Tao Xu, Yunan Xiang, Kun Liu
pmc-13388081.description: PurposeImage-guided thermal ablation (IGTA) is increasingly integrated with systemic therapy for oligometastatic colorectal cancer with lung metastases, but the optimal timing of ablation relative to systemic treatment remains unclear. This study evaluated whether treatment sequencing affects survival and local tumor control.

pmc-13389217.title: Targeting arginine metabolism reverses bone immunosuppressive microenvironment and metastasis in ARID1A-deficient triple negative breast cancer
pmc-13389217.creator: Shuangyue Pan, Jinyan Wang, Boya Wang, Fangqian Wang, Qingjian Chen, Tiantian Liu, Aima Zhang, Shenyuqi Wu, Bin Li, Hai Hu, Mengdi Yang, Zhonghua Tao, Xichun Hu
pmc-13389217.description: Bone metastasis is a lethal consequence of breast cancer. AT-rich interaction domain 1 A gene (ARID1A), a subunit of the switch/sucrose non-fermentable (SWI/SNF) complex, regulates immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. However, its specific role in bone metastasis remains unclear. Here, we show that female patients with ARID1A‑mutated triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) exhibit a higher bone metastasis incidence.

pmc-13399670.title: Terazosin Attenuates Neuronal Pyroptosis by Regulating the Mitochondrial ROS/NLRP3 Inflammasome Axis Through Mitophagy in Cerebral Ischemia–Reperfusion Injury
pmc-13399670.creator: Wei Wang, Xin‐Yue Han, Li‐An Huang, Yu‐Sheng Zhang, Heng Meng, An‐Ding Xu
pmc-13399670.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Cerebral ischemia–reperfusion injury (CI/RI) is a major cause of secondary neuronal damage following ischemic stroke. This study investigated whether terazosin (TZ) exerts neuroprotective effects by regulating mitophagy and the reactive oxygen species (ROS)/NOD‐like receptor protein 3 (NLRP3) inflammasome axis. A mouse model of CI/RI was established and treated with TZ alone or in combination with the mitophagy inhibitor Mdivi‐1 or the NLRP3 activator nigericin.
